title: Button instance on() handlers: model field, FLA import, ActionsPanel wiring, and SWF compile
description:
## Problem

When a Flash 8 FLA has a button instance with inline on(press/release/...) handlers,
the import silently drops them with a warning:

  "[FLA import] button instance on() handlers are not imported (no instance-level model field); skipping"

This breaks round-trip fidelity for any FLA that attaches button behavior at the instance
level rather than the symbol level.

## What's missing (three-layer gap)

### 1. Model: SymbolInstance has no buttonHandlers field
`packages/core/src/engine/types.ts` `SymbolInstance` only carries `clipActions`
(for MC onClipEvent). Button instances need an analogous field, e.g.:
  `readonly buttonHandlers?: readonly ButtonAction[];`

`ButtonAction` is already defined in `packages/core/src/model/types.ts`:
  `event: "press" | "release" | "releaseOutside" | "rollOut" | "rollOver" | "dragOut" | "dragOver"`
  `script: string`

### 2. FLA import: parseClipActions-style parsing for button on() scripts
`packages/core/src/fla/flash8-import.ts` around line 516 already has:
  `if (el.kind === "button" && el.script) { console.warn(... skipping) }`

The `el.script` already contains the raw on() handler text (extracted by `readCPicButton`).
A new `parseButtonHandlers(script)` function should parse it into `ButtonAction[]` and store
it on the SymbolInstance.

### 3. SWF compile: emit instance-level BUTTONCONDACTION via DoInitAction or DoAction
Button instance on() handlers in Flash 8 are emitted as a `DoInitAction` on the containing
sprite timeline that sets up an event listener, OR as a per-frame script that assigns
`myButton_mc.onRelease = function(){}`. The cleanest Flash 8 approach is the latter:
for each button instance that has `buttonHandlers`, emit a frame script (DoAction) that
assigns `<instanceName>.onRelease = function(){...}` etc.

This requires the compile pass to detect `SymbolInstance` objects with a non-empty
`buttonHandlers` array and emit the corresponding AS2 frame actions.

### 4. ActionsPanel wiring (stretch)
`ActionsPanel` currently shows "Actions – Button" mode only when the selected library
symbol is a ButtonSymbol. It should also show the instance-level handlers when a
button instance on the stage is selected.

## Acceptance criteria
1. A document with a button symbol instance with `buttonHandlers: [{event:"release", script:"trace('clicked');"}]`
   publishes a SWF that Ruffle executes the script on click.
2. A real Flash 8 FLA containing button instances with on() handlers imports without
   the "no instance-level model field; skipping" warning.
3. Unit test: `compileDocument` with a button instance + buttonHandlers emits a DoAction
   frame script containing ActionSetMember to assign onRelease.
